entities.name: Church of the Holy Trinity, Samar
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Trinity Cathedral is a church and architectural monument in Samar, Ukraine, the center of the Samara Palanka of the Zaporozhian Sich. It was built in 1772–1781 by the folk architect Yakym Pohribnyak out of wood.
